title: Cerebro
subtitle: LangGraph, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, REST APIs, Next.js
description: Multi-agent RAG research system: a LangGraph supervisor decomposes research questions, routes parallel web, academic, and document tasks, and emits a cited report. Includes human-in-the-loop interrupt/resume gates, checkpoint time-travel, and an offline LLM evaluation harness for citation validity, grounding, recall@k, and faithfulness.

title: Document Automation Platform
subtitle: FastAPI, Gemini, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Pydantic, CI/CD
description: Invoice approval, PO matching, resume screening, and support-ticket triage workflows on one shared pipeline. Gemini outputs are constrained to structured extraction with response_schema and Pydantic validation, while business rules, approvals, and orchestration stay in deterministic Python services. Hardened with retry/backoff, Message-ID idempotency, dedupe hashing, dead-letter handling, and confidence-based human review.

title: Enterprise Knowledge Assistant
subtitle: RAG, ChromaDB, BM25, cross-encoder reranking, retrieval evaluation
description: Hybrid semantic + keyword retrieval with Reciprocal Rank Fusion and cross-encoder reranking. Relevance thresholds drive explicit knowledge-base refusals, evaluated with Hit@k, MRR, grounding quality, and refusal accuracy.
